meta.scope: GS groups whose occupants are vtable slots of ?$TClassFactory@V*@@ template instances (77 instances x 5 slots; slots 1 AddRef / 2 Release have no stack params -> no groups)
meta.ent_id_format: GS:{slot}:{k}:{root} == "GS:" + slot_param_groups.json group key; k indexes IDA-proto stack params excluding this (X134 convention)
meta.canon_name: TClassFactory_{T}; mangled_alias.json variant TClassFactory_V{T}__; til/proto variant _TClassFactory_V{T}; e4 carriers use TClassFactory_{T}
meta.calling_convention_model: slots dispatched as COM __stdcall with receiver self on stack; IDA misdecorated as __thiscall keeping self as first named stack param -> group k0 == COM receiver self for every slot

slot_semantics(binary-verified).0: QueryInterface(self, REFIID riid, void** ppv) retn 0xC - E_POINTER 0x80004003 / E_NOINTERFACE 0x80004002, memcmp IID_IUnknown + 0x7F7CA0, self->AddRef via slot1 [0x6BF8D0, 0x6BFA50]; groups: k0=self k1=riid; ppv unnamed -> no group
slot_semantics(binary-verified).2: Release(self) retn 4 - InterlockedDecrement(self+4), delete when 0 [0x6C0260]; no params
slot_semantics(binary-verified).3: CreateInstance(self, IUnknown* pUnkOuter, REFIID riid, void** ppv) retn 0x10 - CLASS_E_NOAGGREGATION 0x80040110, operator new(sizeof(T)) + T ctor + T::QueryInterface, slot-8 deleting-dtor on failure [0x6C0290, 0x6C4D90, 0x6C0410]; groups: k0=self k1=pUnkOuter k2=riid; ppv named only in BuildingLightClass proto -> GS 3:3 outlier
slot_semantics(binary-verified).4: LockServer(self, BOOL fLock) retn 8 - self+4 refcount +/-1 [0x6C0310, 0x6C4E10, 0x6C0490]; groups: k0=self; fLock unnamed -> no group

deviation_from_task_brief: Task brief placed IUnknown trio at slots 0-2 with CreateInstance/LockServer elsewhere. Binary: slot0=QueryInterface, slot1=AddRef, slot2=Release, slot3=CreateInstance (authority name "ddtor" is a misnomer), slot4=LockServer (authority name "GetSize" is a misnomer).

Task brief assumed thiscall with (This, riid, ppv) param order so k0=riid. Arity proof (retn 0xC/0x10/8) + bodies show stdcall COM receivers: k0=self(factory object), shifting riid/pUnkOuter/riid to k1/k1/k2 and leaving ppv/fLock ungrouped family-wide.

Template-T propagation therefore lands primarily on k0 self (77x3 = receiver class TClassFactory_{T}*), and on created-T only via the single BuildingLight GS 3:3 ppv outlier; created-T out-params of the other 76 instances have no GS group to type.

type_spellings.riid: void *  (REFIID=const GUID*; type_universe.json has _GUID by-value only, no _GUID* spelling)
type_spellings.fLock: int (no group exists; recorded here for downstream consumers only)
type_spellings.class-space note: TClassFactory_{T}* and {T}** spellings are NOT in type_universe.json closed vocabulary (universe = member_types ANCHORED primitives+arrays); solver spans classes separately per its own meta

meta.layering: self params carry two entries (tcf-*-COM-contract void* + tcf-template-T TClassFactory_{T}*); prefer tcf-template-T where class-space types are admissible. GS 3:3 ppv carries void * * + {T}**.
meta.coverage_gaps: No GS groups exist for: slot0 ppvObject, slot4 fLock, slot1/slot2 params (none). Created-T ({T}) propagation is unrepresentable for 76/77 instances at group level; only BuildingLightClass names the ppv param.
